races.paceDynamic: Misterdoc will take them along from the front with no serious pace pressure in this field. The prominent runners Jet Noir, Sears Crossing and C'Mon So lack the class to put sustained pressure on the leader, allowing Misterdoc to dictate terms throughout. With multiple hold-up horses including Mr Maximillian, Eustace Grenier, Jack Dempsey and Palavar needing to come from behind, the pace will be manageable but steady. This controlled tempo strongly favours the front-running and prominent horses who can stay close to the pace without expending energy.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Misterdoc Controls Throughout
scenarios.trigger: If Misterdoc gets an uncontested lead and maintains his jumping rhythm
scenarios.body: The Skelton runner can use his superior class (OR 125) to stretch the field approaching the last, with his recent form showing he stays this trip well. The hold-up horses will find the steady pace hasn't set up their finishing kicks properly.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent Horse Challenge
scenarios.trigger: If Jet Noir or Sears Crossing apply more pressure to Misterdoc than expected
scenarios.body: This creates a stronger tempo that could set up the race for the better hold-up horses to close late. Mr Maximillian and Eustace Grenier would benefit from a more honest gallop to aim at.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Murphy Stable Strike
scenarios.trigger: If the Olly Murphy team execute their plan with multiple runners perfectly positioned
scenarios.body: With three runners (Mr Maximillian, Eustace Grenier, Sears Crossing) they can dictate tactics and set up their best chance. The stable's 7/40 recent record suggests they're in form to capitalize.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Pace Collapses Early
scenarios.trigger: If Misterdoc makes a jumping error or the pace becomes pedestrian through lack of pressure
scenarios.body: This would turn it into a sprint finish where the freshest hold-up horses could pounce late. Jack Dempsey's hold-up style could benefit despite his long absence.

watchPoints.text: Misterdoc's jumping accuracy early on - any mistakes will invite pressure from the prominent horses behind
How much pressure Jet Noir and Sears Crossing apply to the leader through the middle stages
Whether the Murphy stable runners can coordinate their tactics with three in the field
Jack Dempsey's fitness after 163-day layoff - previous runs showed inconsistent jumping
C'Mon So's early position as he's been running prominently but may lack the class to sustain it

races.paceDynamic: El Granjero will lead from the start with no obvious pace pressure, setting a manageable gallop over this marathon trip. Breeze Of Wind, Express Surprise, Stratagem and Upfordebate will track prominently but none have aggressive early pace, allowing El Granjero to dictate terms. The large field of hold-up horses including Busty Boy, Fortunedefortunata, President Scottie and Fever Dream will be patient in the rear divisions. This sustainable pace followed by a late cavalry charge clearly favours the hold-up horses who can unleash finishing kicks.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Horses Dominate
scenarios.trigger: If the pace stays steady through the first two miles allowing closers to wind up
scenarios.body: The patient brigade get perfect positioning as El Granjero's lack of pressure creates ideal conditions for late rushes. Hold-up specialists with proven stamina reserves will sweep past the early leaders in the final half-mile.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Front Runner Steals It
scenarios.trigger: If El Granjero gets away with soft fractions and finds extra reserves
scenarios.body: The sustainable pace allows the leader to maintain energy reserves for a final kick when the closers come hunting. His prominent style gives him first run on the field when they start to close.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Prominent Trackers Strike
scenarios.trigger: If the prominent horses get perfect positioning to kick before the hold-up brigade
scenarios.body: Express Surprise or Stratagem get the jump on both the tiring leader and the still-organising back markers. Their mid-race positioning allows them to time their move perfectly between the two divisions.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Pace Collapses Early
scenarios.trigger: If El Granjero sets crawling fractions that become a sprint finish
scenarios.body: The race becomes a tactical crawl that turns into a cavalry charge where any horse can win on the day. Positioning becomes more important than stamina as it develops into a group sprint.

watchPoints.text: El Granjero could get away with soft fractions early and prove hard to peg back if allowed to dictate completely unchallenged
Busty Boy and Fever Dream both have strong recent form and ideal hold-up styles for this pace scenario
Express Surprise has winning form but 40 days off could blunt his edge in a competitive handicap
The prominent horses like Stratagem and Upfordebate may get caught between the leader and closers tactically
President Scottie drops significantly in weight and Nicky Richards has good recent form with 3 winners from 12 runners

races.paceDynamic: Inferno Sacree and Jukebox Fury are the confirmed front-runners who will contest the early lead, with Inferno Sacree showing particularly strong recent form (222112) and likely to take them along at a decent clip. Go To War and Sleedagh will sit prominent tracking the pace, but with 9 hold-up horses in the field, the majority will be settling towards the rear early on. The honest gallop set by the two leaders will create a searching test over this extended 3m2½f trip, with the pace likely to tell in the closing stages. This race shape strongly favours the hold-up horses who can stay off the pace and finish with one sustained run.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Hold-up horses dominate
scenarios.trigger: If the front two set a strong gallop and the race becomes truly run
scenarios.body: The searching pace will find out the pace-setters and prominent runners, allowing the patient hold-up brigade to sweep past in the final half-mile. The tactical advantage goes to horses like Jupiter Des Mottes and Roaring Conquest who can time one decisive move.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent runners strike
scenarios.trigger: If Go To War or Sleedagh can get the perfect trip tracking the leaders
scenarios.body: They avoid the worst of the early pace but stay close enough to pounce when the front-runners weaken, getting first run on the hold-up horses. This tactical positioning proves ideal for the extended distance.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Inferno Sacree stays strong
scenarios.trigger: If Inferno Sacree can dictate a more manageable pace from the front
scenarios.body: His excellent recent form (three seconds and two wins) suggests he's peaking, and controlling the tempo could allow him to outstay his rivals. Murray Dodd's 7lb claim becomes crucial in a tight finish.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Pace collapses completely
scenarios.trigger: If both front-runners go too slow or get into a tactical battle
scenarios.body: The race becomes a sprint finish where class tells rather than stamina, suiting the higher-rated horses regardless of running style. This would be the least likely scenario given both leaders' forward-going styles.

watchPoints.text: Inferno Sacree and Jukebox Fury could go too fast early if they get into a pace duel, which would set up the hold-up horses perfectly
Jupiter Des Mottes needs to be produced with one run as he's a hold-up specialist who must have everything fall right tactically
Go To War's ability to get the right position behind the leaders will be crucial as he needs to avoid getting caught wide or in traffic
The 7lb and 5lb claiming jockeys on Inferno Sacree, Wa Wa and Musique De Fee could prove significant in a tight finish
Highland Fashion's trainer has not had a runner for 14 days and shows poor recent form which raises fitness concerns

This setup strongly favours hold-up horses like Solly Attwell who can avoid the early congestion and finish through tired horses.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Early Leader Wires Field
scenarios.trigger: If Celestial Fashion gets first run and the pace collapses behind the leaders
scenarios.body: His recent winning form over similar trips allows him to maintain the advantage. The prominent horses fail to coordinate their challenge effectively.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Pace Collapse Chaos
scenarios.trigger: If both leaders go too slow and the field bunches entering the straight

scenarios.label: C

races.paceDynamic: The Coffey Boy will lead unchallenged early with five horses (Valette, Ayyadieh, Zephlyn, Pepite De Saphir, Nae Bother At A') wanting prominent positions creating inevitable congestion. This cluster will be forced wide or into traffic approaching 3 out, while The Coffey Boy maintains control up front on the rail. The pace will be sustainable early but accelerate from 4 out as the prominent group tries to organize, creating perfect conditions for the hold-up horses (Berkenshtaaap, Mr Jukebox, Walk On Son, Velvet Vulcan) to exploit the chaos. This race shape strongly favours patient hold-up performers who can navigate the early squeeze and deliver late.

scenarios.label: A

scenarios.trigger: If the prominent pack creates the expected traffic jam from 3 out while The Coffey Boy maintains control
scenarios.body: The five prominent runners will interfere with each other's momentum while the patient hold-up brigade finds cleaner passages to deliver their finishing kicks. Berkenshtaaap and Mr Jukebox particularly benefit from this tactical meltdown.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: The Coffey Boy Stays Clear
scenarios.trigger: If The Coffey Boy gets an easy lead and the prominent pack fails to mount sustained pressure
scenarios.body: The leader exploits the congestion behind to steal crucial lengths, while one prominent runner (likely Valette or Pepite De Saphir) emerges from the scrum to chase. The hold-up horses arrive too late despite the pace scenario.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Prominent Runner Breaks Free
scenarios.trigger: If one of the prominent quintet positions perfectly and avoids the inevitable traffic
scenarios.body: Zephlyn or Ayyadieh times their move to perfection before the congestion peaks, getting first run on The Coffey Boy. They maintain momentum while others struggle behind, holding off the late hold-up challenge.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Pace Collapse Scenario
scenarios.trigger: If The Coffey Boy goes too slow and the prominent pack remains patient until late
scenarios.body: The race becomes a sprint from 2 out with no real pace pressure early, negating the hold-up horses' usual advantage. The prominent runners with most early speed (Valette, Pepite De Saphir) can outkick the field.

The pace scenario clearly favours patient, staying types who can pick up the pieces when the early leaders tire.

scenarios.label: A
